## Leadership & Community

Outside the lab and classroom, I help build community at Harvey Mudd through the **Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers**, **SALSA Mudd**, and residential, admissions, and teaching roles that support other students.

---

## Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers: Harvey Mudd College {#shpe}

**Co-Founder & Co-President | December 2025 – Present**

I co-founded the Harvey Mudd chapter of SHPE and serve as one of its Co-Presidents, building the chapter's professional development programming and the funding that gets students to national events.

### Building the Chapter

- Established the Mudd SHPE chapter
- Organize professional development workshops, industry speaker events, and networking sessions

### Funding & National Convention

- Secured **$10,000+** in sponsorship funding to send **12 students** to the SHPE National Convention

---

## SALSA Mudd {#salsa}

**Co-President | August 2025 – May 2026**

Co-President of the Society for Advancement of Latino Students at Mudd (SALSA Mudd).
